# CAF Guide: code map

**What it is:** An unofficial study app for the Canadian Armed Forces: active-recall flashcards on ranks, structure, training, history and acronyms, with a daily review.
**Live:** https://caf-guide.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/Guild · **Layout:** JavaScript pages + tools/deploy.py (not native Forms yet) · **Deploy:** branch-first
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `Guild/.claude/skills/caf-guide/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- Edit the **project source in this folder**; GitHub only holds the built output (`tools/deploy.py` builds
  `theme/assets/app.js`/`app.css` from `web/`). Never edit `tools/.anvil-repo`.
- **New page**: `web/pages/<name>.html` with `UI.page('<name>', {title, auth, nav}, mount)`. Shared engines: `web/pages/_*.html`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in `server_code/<Module>.py`; call it from a page with `UI.api('name', {...})`.
- **New table/column**: `TABLES` in `tools/sync_to_anvil.py` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert after deploy).
- **Header, footer, tab bar**: `web/app.js`. Shared helpers: `web/core.js` (`window.UI`). Tokens + components: `web/core.css`.
- **Check**: `python -I tools/check.py --ui` → ALL CHECKS PASSED. Look: `tools/preview/devserver.py` + `tools/preview/shots.py`.
- **Deploy**: `python tools/deploy.py` (dry run), then `python tools/deploy.py --push "Message"`.
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py guild` refreshes this map.

## Data tables (`tools/sync_to_anvil.py` TABLES)

- **users**: display_name:str, bio:str, avatar_color:str, is_admin:bool, xp:num, streak:num, last_active:date, legal_version:str, legal_accepted_at:dt, legal_source:str · used in QuizService
- **collections**: title:str, description:str, kind:str, color:str, position:num, published:bool, created:dt · used in QuizService
- **quizzes**: collection→collections, title:str, description:str, difficulty:str, position:num, card_count:num, published:bool, source:str, created:dt · used in QuizService
- **questions**: quiz→quizzes, position:num, text:str, answer:str, explanation:str, concept:str · used in QuizService
- **card_state**: user→users, question→questions, quiz→quizzes, box:num, due:date, reviews:num, lapses:num, last_reviewed:dt · used in QuizService
- **sessions**: user→users, quiz→quizzes, finished:dt, reviewed:num, got:num, again:num, xp:num, ratings:obj · used in QuizService

## Tools

- `tools/build_acronyms.py`: Build the acronym dictionary used by the header's Lookup panel.
- `tools/build_modules.py`: Turn the flashcard sources in cards_src/ into importable JSON files in modules/.
- `tools/check.py`: Fast checks before deploying. Run from anywhere:
- `tools/deploy.py`: Deploy the project to the live Anvil app through its GitHub repo.
- `tools/make_loading_icon.py`: Split loading_icon.png into the two layers of the loading spinner.
- `tools/sync_to_anvil.py`: Write this project into an Anvil app's git checkout (the repo Anvil syncs with GitHub).
